verdict.rationale: Cline is primarily an IDE/CLI extension, not a standalone desktop app; diff review is well documented (edits shown as diffs with revert/checkpoints) and Cline Kanban provides a web-based task board for running multiple agents in parallel with isolated worktrees, satisfying the 'multiple sessions side by side' need, but this is a web UI rather than a native desktop app. missing for 10: evidence of a true native desktop application (not web-based Kanban) combining visual diff review and parallel session management in one unified UI, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the Kanban board experience.
